# tenure rights

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:tenureRights`](gmeow-tenureRights.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/tenureRights>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The machine-readable rights statement (permissions, prohibitions, duties) that governs this land tenure. Links to the rights facility rights facility by reference. Non-functional: multiple legal instruments may apply to the same tenure (e.g. national law + local ordinance + indigenous treaty).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:LandTenure`](../classes/gmeow-LandTenure.md) -> [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a land tenure to the machine-readable rights statement governing it; non-functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid inlining deontic rules — reference a [`RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) from the rights slice.

### How to use

- Point [`gmeow:tenureRights`](gmeow-tenureRights.md) at one or more [`gmeow:RightsStatement`](../classes/gmeow-RightsStatement.md) instances; multiple instruments may apply.
